layman_headline: Market fear is easing but no clear new opportunity — holding current positions.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is still in a fearful state, but sentiment is improving slightly from deep fear a few days ago. Our two current positions — Solana and Chainlink — are both near breakeven. LINK has strong momentum with a 15% gain over the past week and 7% in the last 24 hours, while SOL is consolidating. The swing trade candidates on the watchlist are mostly overextended coins that have already surged 80-180% in a week, making them too risky to chase. Better to let our existing positions play out.
layman_action: Hold your current SOL and LINK positions. Both are within their trading ranges and haven't hit stop-losses or profit targets yet. Wait for a pullback opportunity in a quality coin before adding a new position.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present poor risk/reward: AKE has RSI 91.72 (extreme overbought after +182% in 7 days), VELVET is pulling back -10.7% after an 84% run, H surged 96% with no RSI data to confirm sustainability, and ETHFI/FET lack technical data. BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to suppress altcoin performance broadly. The Fear & Greed index improving from 29 to 34 is a positive sign but not yet at levels that historically signal strong buying opportunities. Current holdings SOL and LINK both have defined stop-losses and are within their expected trading ranges — patience is warranted.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to drain capital from altcoins, potentially stalling LINK and SOL rallies
Swan CEO's comment that 'altcoins are basically dead' reflects bearish institutional sentiment that could become self-fulfilling
Fear & Greed at 34 is improving but still in fear territory — a BTC drop below $60K could trigger another wave of selling
watch_list: BTC price action around $63K support — a break below $60K would trigger portfolio stop-loss reviews
LINK volume sustainability — today's $506M volume needs to hold to confirm the breakout isn't a fakeout
Fear & Greed trend — if it continues improving toward 40+ it would support adding a third position
market_context: The crypto market is in a cautious recovery phase with BTC at $63K and Fear & Greed improving from 29 to 34. High BTC dominance at 56.1% and headlines about 'dead altcoins' suggest selective positioning in only the strongest alts is prudent.
context_banner: Market fear is easing but BTC dominance remains elevated — hold existing quality positions and wait for better entry opportunities.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 34 (Fear) improving from 29 — directionally positive but not yet at levels that justify aggressive new entries.
AKE RSI at 91.72 confirms extreme overbought conditions across the top swing candidates, making chasing these rallies dangerous.
Tokenized stock holders more than doubling supports LINK's oracle thesis, reinforcing our existing LINK position.
LINK trading $506M in 24h volume with +7.1% daily gain shows genuine institutional interest rather than retail speculation.
UBS ramping Bitcoin ETF exposure 24-fold and Paul Tudor Jones increasing IBIT stake signal institutional accumulation that should support broader market recovery.
